description:
Swapping the SessionStart hook in `.claude/settings.json` from `bd prime --hook-json` to `bn prime --hook-json` fails immediately:

    error: unexpected argument '--hook-json' found

`bn prime` accepts --full, --json, --mcp, --repo, --actor, --stealth, --export, --namespace -- no --hook-json. Upstream beads ships that flag; our fork never picked it up, so any config or doc written against upstream `bd` silently breaks when pointed at `bn`.

WORKAROUND IN PLACE: the hook now runs `bn prime --mcp`, documented as "Force compact MCP/editor-hook output", which is the nearest equivalent. SessionStart hooks accept plain stdout as injected context, so no JSON envelope is actually required -- verified rc=0 and it emits the compact Beads Workflow block (already `bn`-worded, not `bd`).

DECIDE: either add --hook-json as an alias for the hook-shaped output (keeps upstream configs portable), or leave it out deliberately and say so in the fork's docs. Right now it is neither -- just an undocumented gap that turns into a broken hook at session start, which is the worst place to find it since a failing SessionStart hook is easy to miss.
title: bn prime lacks --hook-json, so upstream bd hook configs break on the fork
